operativeSourceText:
Section 1.01 of the Credit Agreement is
hereby amended by adding the following definitions in the appropriate alphabetical order:
“Invoice
Restrictions” has the meaning set forth in the Monthly Factoring Report.
“Maintenance Liquidity”
means, as of any date of determination, (a) the sum as of such date of (x) the aggregate amount of the commitments under the Super-Priority Revolving Credit Facility (including the aggregate revolving commitments with respect to any
Permitted Euro Revolving Indebtedness) (or any Refinancing Indebtedness in respect thereof) minus (y) the aggregate principal amount of the outstanding revolving loans under the Super-Priority Revolving Credit Facility and any
outstanding revolving loans in respect of any Permitted Euro Revolving Indebtedness (or any Refinancing Indebtedness in respect thereof) and, in each case, the face amount of any letters of credit issued thereunder (less any reimbursed amounts)
plus (b) the “Adjustment to Liquidity” as set forth in the most recently delivered Monthly Factoring Report plus (c) unrestricted cash and Cash Equivalents of the Borrower and its Subsidiaries.

“Monthly Factoring Report” means a report substantially in
the form of Exhibit E or any other form approved by the Administrative Agent.

irExtensionCandidates.sourceEvidence: §2(a): “Adjustment to Liquidity” as set forth in the most recently delivered Monthly Factoring Report; and “Invoice Restrictions” has the meaning set forth in the Monthly Factoring Report (itself a report substantially in the form of Exhibit E, which is on file with the Administrative Agent and not incorporated as searchable text).
irExtensionCandidates.semanticRequirement: A way to flag that a defined term's or formula operand's value is not fixed by the agreement text but is instead whatever figure/criteria appears in a periodically-delivered, externally-templated report/exhibit (here, a Monthly Factoring Report per Exhibit E) - distinct from an ordinary METRIC_REFERENCE to a financial-statement-derived metric like EBITDA, because the reporting template itself, not just its computed output, is outside the four corners of the agreement.
irExtensionCandidates.whyExistingPrimitivesFail: METRIC_REFERENCE can name the value but cannot express that its source is a delivered-report line item governed by an exhibit template subject to Administrative Agent approval/substitution, which is a materially different provenance/reliability signal than an internally-defined financial metric.
irExtensionCandidates.candidateGeneralizedPrimitive: REPORT_DERIVED_VALUE_REFERENCE (reportName, lineItem, formTemplateRef) - a reference node analogous to METRIC_REFERENCE but explicitly tagged as sourced from a periodic third-party-form report rather than computed from the agreement's own defined financial metrics.
